owen_mm_fiducial.statement: Minimal match fiducial used in the note and in Owen's benchmark.
owen_mm_fiducial.from_scratch: Inserted as the benchmark input and used in all derived calculations.
choices: Use Owen's fiducial value so the reproduction is directly comparable to the paper.

owen_mm097_rate_fraction.statement: Worst-case accessible event-rate fraction MM^3 at MM=0.97.
choices: Used the Euclidean homogeneous-source approximation stated by Owen.

owen_mm097_rate_loss.statement: Worst-case fractional event-rate loss 1-MM^3 at MM=0.97.
owen_mm097_rate_loss.from_scratch: Subtracted the computed retained fraction from unity.
choices: Reported the exact decimal before displaying it as 8.73 percent.

owen_event_loss_benchmark.statement: Approximate event-rate loss used to normalize Owen's historical count and compute-cost benchmarks.
owen_event_loss_benchmark.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Secs. III B-D.
choices: Recorded as the paper's approximate benchmark rather than equating it to the exact MM=0.97 loss.

owen_initial_fs_hz.statement: Seismic cutoff frequency for Owen's initial-LIGO analytic PSD.
owen_initial_fs_hz.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Sec. II B and encoded through fs/f0=1/5 with f0=200 Hz.
choices: Historical PSD retained for paper reproduction, not as a modern detector model.

owen_initial_f0_hz.statement: Knee frequency for Owen's initial-LIGO analytic PSD.
owen_initial_f0_hz.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Sec. II B.
choices: Historical value retained for direct comparison.

owen_advanced_fs_hz.statement: Seismic cutoff frequency for Owen's historical advanced-LIGO analytic PSD.
owen_advanced_fs_hz.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Sec. II B and encoded through fs/f0=1/7 with f0=70 Hz.

owen_advanced_f0_hz.statement: Knee frequency for Owen's historical advanced-LIGO analytic PSD.
owen_advanced_f0_hz.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Sec. II B.
choices: Historical value retained for direct comparison.

recomputed_initial_metric_11.from_scratch: Noise moments integrated and Eq. (34) implemented directly.

recomputed_initial_sqrt_det.statement: Square root of the determinant of the recomputed initial-LIGO dimensionless metric.
recomputed_initial_sqrt_det.from_scratch: Computed from the full-precision projected metric.

recomputed_initial_eigenvalue_stiff.from_scratch: Closed-form eigendecomposition of the full-precision 2x2 metric.

recomputed_initial_eigenvalue_soft.statement: Smaller eigenvalue of the recomputed initial-LIGO dimensionless metric.

owen_minimum_mass_solar.statement: Minimum component mass in solar masses for Owen's expansive benchmark domain.
owen_minimum_mass_solar.from_scratch: Transcribed from Owen Sec. III B as an input to the domain integral.
choices: Retained the historical lower-mass assumption for direct reproduction.

recomputed_initial_area_s2.statement: Deterministically integrated initial-LIGO chirp-time coordinate area in square seconds.
recomputed_initial_area_s2.from_scratch: Derived the Jacobian, integrated total mass analytically, and quadrature-integrated symmetric mass ratio.
choices: Used an infinite upper mass bound to match Owen and a current solar-mass time conversion.

owen_reported_initial_area_s2.from_scratch: No derivation; benchmark transcribed from Owen Sec. III B.
choices: Kept Owen's printed precision to expose the comparison with deterministic quadrature.

owen_reported_advanced_area_s2.statement: Historical advanced-LIGO chirp-time coordinate area reported by Owen in square seconds.

recomputed_advanced_template_count.statement: Recomputed historical advanced-LIGO square-grid template count at MM=0.97, rounded to four significant digits.

q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r01.statement: Raw total tokens recorded by the first failed q1bC Astra PI session.
q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r01.from_scratch: Read the final cumulative token-usage event from the persisted Codex session.
q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r01.from_library: Codex CLI session accounting; no numerical library.
choices: Used raw total tokens, including cached input, because the purpose is to reconcile the job's token guard rather than estimate API price.

q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r02.statement: Raw total tokens recorded by the second failed q1bC Astra PI session.
q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r02.from_scratch: Read the final cumulative token-usage event from the persisted Codex session.
q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_r02.from_library: Codex CLI session accounting; no numerical library.
choices: Used raw total tokens, including cached input, because the purpose is to reconcile the job's token guard rather than estimate API price.

q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_total.statement: Combined raw token count of the two failed q1bC Astra PI sessions.
q1bc_astra_loop_tokens_total.from_scratch: Added the two persisted cumulative session totals.
choices: Excluded the successful Claude verifier call and the later preflight so this number describes only the Astra hook loop.

q1bc_reconciled_job_tokens_before_resume.statement: Reconciled q1bC job token counter before resumption: both Astra PI sessions plus the completed Claude verifier call.

q1bc_reconciled_job_tokens_before_resume.from_library: Codex CLI session accounting and agent-team log.jsonl accounting.
